Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The England players stride out to the middle. Followed by Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan who walk out to open for India. It will be Reece Topley to start with the new ball.
... The Run Chase ...

Now the target is yet again not a big one but could be a tricky one. India failed to chase down something lesser in the last game. The wicket does have some pace in it and there is some bounce but India will back themselves to chase this down. England on the other hand, will yet again have to take wickets early. If they do so, GAME ON! Stay tuned for the second half.

Hardik Pandya is in for a quick chat. He says he did bent his back a bit. He realized that full deliveries won't work on this wicket and changed his plan accordingly. Mentions for him it was simple. He knew Livingstone takes on the short ball, and tried to be persistent with his length. There would only be one winner in the battle. Further adds even after going for a couple of sixes, he spoke to the skipper and continued with the same plan.

India bowled with a plan! Initially they kept it fuller as it was swinging. Siraj got the early breakthroughs for his side but it was Hardik who was the wrecker in chief. He was the one who provided the vital breakthroughs for India. He got Stokes, Roy and bowled that one over where he got the better for Liam and Buttler. That was probably the over which changed the game into the favor of the visitors. The Indian bowlers did go for runs but the good thing for them was, they kept taking wickets. Yuzvendra Chahal cleared up the tail quickly in the death that should help him with the momentum.

The problem for England was they kept losing wickets at regular intervals! They lost two at the very start! Then there was a partnership between Roy and Stokes. However, both Roy and Stokes then fell in quick succession. Ali and Buttler then steadied the ship and when the two were batting, the tide had changed towards their side. However, as the game seemed to be slipping away, India got the wicket of Moeen and since then, it all went downward for the hosts. They lost Buttler and Livingstone in quick succession. Then there was yet another stand between Willey and Overton but once they lost Willey, the last two wickets did not stay out there for long. The hosts probably could have played with a lot more caution and they may have gotten to a score which would have at least been par.

OUT! TIMBER! Yuzvendra Chahal hits the top of middle to end this English innings. This is a googly, lands outside off and turns in a long way. Reece Topley strides a long way across and tries to defend it out but misses. The ball goes past the inside edge and shatters the stumps. ENGLAND END THEIR INNINGS AT 259/10.

Have to say India will be the happier of the two sides at the moment! But one can really question the bang, bang approach from England! Quite a few shots from their batters can be questioned. They will be disappointed as they should have easily got to something around 300 but we feel they are under par here on a wicket which has played decently.
WIDE! Slower one, wide outside off, Reece Topley leaves it alone. Wide called.
Full, wide outside off. Carse comes down the track and whips it down to long on for one.

OUT! CAUGHT! Yuzvendra Chahal gets his second wicket. It is full and on off. Craig Overton clears his front leg and tonks it down the ground towards long off. He could not get the desired distance on it. It only meets Virat Kohli in the deep, well inside the boundary. Reece Topley is the last man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Virat Kohli b Yuzvendra Chahal

Commentary.Commentary: On off, defended out.
SIX! Craig Overton starts the over with a biggie. Pressure back on Chahal. It is full and outside off. Overton dances down the track and smokes it over the long off fence.
Full and on off. Carse blocks it back to the bowler. Just two runs off the over.
Quicker and full, on the pads, Carse nudges it to mid-wicket yet again.
Looped up, on the pads, tucked to mid-wicket.
Floated and full, on the pads. Overton flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
It is full and on off. Carse sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Drifts it in, full and on leg. Carse blocks it back to the bowler.
CHANGE! Ravindra Jadeja comes onto bowl now.
Floated and full, outside off. Carse taps it to point for one.
This is worked through mid on for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Yuzvendra Chahal gets himself into the wicket's column. India really needed this breakthrough. It is floated and full, outside off. David Willey comes down the track, reaches out and lofts it towards long off. He does not get the desired distance on it and Suryakumar Yadav takes a sitter in the deep. Brydon Carse is the new man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Suryakumar Yadav b Yuzvendra Chahal

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up and full, on off. Craig Overton lofts it down the ground. He could not get the connection due to the slow pace. It meets the fielder on a bounce. They take one.
Top spin now, on the pads. Willey stays back and flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Full length, wide outside off. Craig Overton gets low and whips it down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Glorious boundary. Back of a length, outside off. David Willey punches it through covers for a boundary.
Short ball, on off. Craig Overton pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Length ball, on off. Overton pushes it to cover.
WIDE! A slower one, angled down leg. Craig Overton leaves it alone. Wide called.
A couple of runs now! Length ball, on middle and leg. Craig Overton flicks it through the gap at mid-wicket. The batters take two before the fielder cuts it out.
Back of a length, on off. Craig Overton looks to pull it away but misses.
Short ball, down leg. David Willey pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Another one on the stumps, kept out well.
On off, defended.
Two more! Short and on the body, this is pulled towards fine leg for two.
Length ball, angled down leg. David Willey flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Siraj goes full again, on off. Overton eases it to long on for a single.
Full length, on middle and leg. Craig Overton flicks it to short mid-wicket.

FIVE WIDES! More free runs for England. It is a sharp bouncer, on off. Craig Overton just watches the ball sail over. It is way above Pant as well. The umpire signals a wide as the ball races away to the boundary.
Full length, on off. Willey drives it to cover. 12 runs off the over. 300 is looking back in sight for England.

SIX! BOOM! David Willey gets into the act now. This is a good sign for the hosts. It is a length ball, on off. David Willey reads the length early and smokes it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Length ball, on the pads, Overton tucks it to square leg for one.
FOUR! Goes off the middle. Short ball, on off. Craig Overton stands tall and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for four. He makes the most of the freebie.
NO BALL! High full toss, on off. Craig Overton stays back and blocks it to cover. The umpire signals a no ball. A Free Hit to follow.
Full length, on off. Overton drives it to mid off but straight to the fielder.
It is full, outside off. Craig Overton gets on his front foot and defends it to cover.
Powerplay 2 comes to an end! Now, 5 fielders can be placed outside the inner circle until the end of the innings. Prasidh Krishna comes back into the attack.
Two to end the over! Siraj bangs it short again. this is pulled again through mid-wicket for another couple.
Goes short again, this is pulled down to fine leg for another single.
Another pacey short one. Overton is beaten for pace as he tries to pull.
Shorter and on middle, defended.
Two is the call and two is what they get! On the pads, this is worked wide of fine leg for two.
Singles is what England will have to be content with at the moment! On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
A short ball to end, on the body, Overton looks to pull but it hits the glove and rolls towards the keeper. 6 from the over.

Nice and fine! Really good fielding though from Chahal! Short and on the body, Craig Overton looks to pull, it goes off the top edge fine on the leg side. Chahal who is quite fine in the third man region runs to his left, dives and pushes it back in. The fine leg fielder was quite square does the mopping up job. Two taken.
Goes back to bowling it short and on middle, Overton evades it.

Misfield and two! Not what India want right now. They have their tails up and they would not be wanting to give away free runs. Fuller and on middle, this is driven towards mid on. Krishna lets it through and two is taken.
Good length and on off, defended.
Nicely placed! Outside off, on the shorter side, this is guided through point for two.
Overton retains strike! On a length and around off, this is pushed through cover.
This time he does get the single! On the pads, this is flicked towards square leg.
Yet another dot! On the pads, Willey flicks it to mid-wicket again.
Slower through the air and on middle, Willey works it to mid-wicket.
On middle, Willey works it to mid-wicket.
On middle, this is worked down to long on for one. Overton gets off the mark. 200 up for England.
Craig Overton is the new batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a wonderful catch! Pandya has two in the over and two huge wickets. The game has turned on its head! England looked all set for 300 before this over started but now they are in big trouble with only the all-rounders left. Another short ball does the trick! This is on middle, Buttler looks to pull but once again fails to get on top of the bounce, it goes off the top edge towards deep mid-wicket. Jadeja makes a lot of ground to his left and takes it with a dive. Buttler needed to stay out there for longer. India will try and keep England to under 270 now.
Commentary.Howout: c Ravindra Jadeja b Hardik Pandya

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and on middle, Willey looks to pull, gets no timing, it rolls on the leg side for one.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
David Willey is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Hardik Pandya gets the better of Liam Livingstone yet again! This is short, not very short but fractionally short. Into the body. Liam Livingstone looks to pull, it goes more off the inner half towards Ravindra Jadeja who takes a really good catch at the square leg fence. He had to keep his balance as he was just ahead of the ropes. Liam has given it away. With already a biggie in the over, this was not needed.
Commentary.Howout: c Ravindra Jadeja b Hardik Pandya

Commentary.Commentary: Hardik continues to bang it short. Ducked under.
SIX! That is huge! Colossal! The short ball ploy is a little too predictable now. Liam Livingstone is ready for it, he smashes it over the square leg fence. NEW BALLS PLEASE!
Another dot to end! On off, on the shorter side again, Buttler pushes it to covers.
Tossed up on off, defended.
Very well bowled! Sees Buttler come down the track and bowls it outside off, it is pushed to cover.
Liam steps out but almost yorks himself, he hits it down to long on for one.
Another one tossed up on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Tossed up on off, this is hit down to long off for one.
The physio comes out to conduct a mandatory concussion test on Liam Livingstone as he gets pinged on his helmet. He seems to be fine.
Liam Livingstone now has been hit on the helmet! This is short yet again, Liam once again wants to pull, he gets a top edge and then the ball hits him on the helmet.
Another short one, a lot more effort into this one as it gets big on the batter. Liam defends by taking one hand off the handle.
SIX! That has been hit with some power! He really latches onto this one. It is short and on middle, Liam seems to be waiting for it. He thumps it over the square leg fence.
One feels this is probably pre-meditated. This is short, fractionally short. Could have pulled this but ducks under it.
A short one, on the body, Liam throws the kitchen sink at it but is beaten. This is a good contest, Hardik has had the better of Liam so far in this series.
Three! That has been timed brilliantly! On a length and around off, this is hit through covers. Iyer, the sub, gives it a chase and keeps it down to three.
Change. Hardik Pandya (4-3-2-2) is back into the attack.
On middle, slightly fuller, Buttler strokes it down to long on and takes one.
Two this time! Fuller and outside off, Buttler reaches out for it and hits it through covers for two.
Shorter and on off, Liam pushes it through covers for one.
Tosses it above the eyeline again and lands it on leg, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Really well bowled! Nice and slow, drags the batter forward, it is driven to covers.
On the pads again, this is worked through square leg for one.
WIDE! Slower but slips this down the leg side. Buttler looks to flick but misses.
FOUR! That is beautiful and the last ball spoils the over somewhat! Fuller and on off, Liam Livingstone shows the full face of the bat and times it past mid off for a boundary.
Shorter again and around off, Buttler guides it down to third man for one.
Well fielded! That was driven nicely! Fuller and on off, Buttler strokes it on the up but to covers.
On the fuller side and on off, Buttler pushes it to mid off.
Brilliant! Odl fashion bowling! A bumper followed by a yorker. It was just outside off. Buttler was late in getting his bat down. Unlucky Krishna.
Shorter and outside off, Buttler looks to play it over the keeper but misses.
A loud appeal but that was bat first! Fires it on off, Liam looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Lofted again but wide of the cover fielder and down towards long off for one.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Fifty for Buttler! The skipper comes to the fore when his side needed him to. Still though, he would know there is a lot to do. On off, this is guided through covers for one.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! What a shot! Lovely placement! This is fuller and on off, Buttler makes room, goes inside-out over covers for a boundary.
Just a single off the over then. It is on a length, around off. Liam Livingstone stays inside the crease and blocks it late towards third man.
Liam Livingstone stays back and blocks this length delivery towards point with an angled bat.
Good length, on top of off. Liam Livingstone yells no run as soon as he smothers it to covers.
A low full toss, outside off. Jos Buttler moves across and works it to sweeper cover for one. Shikhar Dhawan makes no mistake in the deep.
Full length, on the pads, Buttler flicks it to the leg side.
Full length, angled into the pads. Jos Buttler drives it firmly back to the bowler. Prasidh Krishna is quick to bend down and collect the ball.
A single to end! On the shorter side outside off. Buttler strokes it through covers and takes one.
Shortish and on off, this is played through covers for one more.
Another single as this is eased down to long off.
Fires it on middle, Buttler blocks.
On middle, this is kept out.
On off, Buttler strokes it through covers for one.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Another good short one, takes Liam by surprise. He fends it off.
Fuller and on off, Liam guides it to point. The fielder does well to dive to his right and save a run for his side.
A good bumper, a sharp one. Liam Livingstone evades it well.
This one stays a touch low! On a length and around middle, Liam gets his bat down in time and defends.
Back of a length and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Two more! Jadeja is not happy with the effort in the field! Flatter and on off, Liam Livingstone pushes it through covers. It is away from the sweeper. Two taken.

FOUR! Yes, he does! Really good from Liam Livingstone! Jadeja too tried to outsmart him but Liam adjusted well. He walks right across to look to heave it on the leg side. Jadeja fires it outside off. Liam adjusts and hits it over the cover fielder for a boundary.
Fired into the pads, defended again. No ball signaled! Liam has a gift now to get off the mark. Can he make use of it?
Slightly shorter and around off, Liam looks to push at it, it goes off the inner half back to the bowler.
Flatter and on middle, Liam pushes it back to the bowler.

DRINKS! This early wicket by Jadeja allows all the players to take a breather as the umpire signals a drinks break. England were looking solid with the pair of Buttler-Ali moving along really well, although the latter slipped out. Is this the opening India were after? Can they make the most of it? We shall find out soon. Liam Livingstone joins his skipper in the middle. He can go berserk if he wishes too.

OUT! TAKEN! Jadeja comes on and he strikes! Breaks the stand that had started to flourish. Moeen looks to play the sweep, Jadeja fires it on middle. It goes off the glove and Pant takes a good catch down the leg side. Timely wicket as the two were really getting a move on. Moeen walks back after getting off to yet another start.
Commentary.Howout: c Rishabh Pant b Ravindra Jadeja

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Length ball, around middle and leg. Jos Buttler flicks it to the leg side. Just two runs off the over then.
Back of a length, on off. Ali pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Length ball, on middle. This one zips through. Ali tries to clip it away but gets it back to the bowler off the outer half.
Mohammad Shami serves it on a length, outside off, from around the wicket. Moeen Ali stays back and defends it out watchfully.
A short ball, on the body. Jos Buttler pulls it to deep square leg for a single. The stand moves to 74.
Full length, outside off. Jos Buttler drives it to cover but not in the gap.
On the pads, tucked to square leg. An expensive over by Yuzvendra Chahal. 16 runs off it. These two batters seem to be settled now.
SIX! Second maximum of the over! Moeen Ali gets into the act now. It is full and outside off. Moeen Ali goes down on one knee and slog sweeps it over the wide long on fence for a biggie.
It is tossed up, full and outside off. Ali gets it to third man off the outside edge. They take a couple.
Fraction short, outside off. Butter stays back and cuts it to deep point for a single.
SIX! Jos Buttler is attacking the spinner really well. It is tossed up, full and on off. Jos Buttler dances down the track and smokes it over the long on fence for a maximum.
Floated, around off, this one turns in a touch. Moeen Ali flicks it to square leg off his pads and crosses.
Two dots in a row! Shami goes full and outside off. Jos Buttler leans in and drives it to mid off. He finds the fielder. Mohammad Shami starts his second spell on a good note.
Full length, on off. Jos Buttler defends it to the on side.
LEG BYE! Slower one, on the pads. Ali fails to flick it away. The ball rolls out to square leg off his pads. They collect a leg bye.
A length ball, outside off. Jos Buttler cuts it to deep point for one.
Length ball, on off, blocked out.
On a length, around off, this one zips through. Moeen Ali it taken aback by the extra bounce. He lobs it to the leg side. They take one.
Change! Mohammad Shami comes back on! He has a record against Buttler, not sure why he was not got on earlier.
Full, on leg, Ali flicks it through square leg for a single.
A single now as this is worked through covers.
Tossed up, around off. Buttler pushes it to cover, straight to the fielder.
On off, driven to covers.
Floated and full, on the stumps. Jos Buttler blocks it out.
Full and on off. Ali pushes it to long on for one.
Another crisp drive but for one! On off, this is pushed wide of mid off for one.
SIX! That has been smacked! This could well be the momentum changing over! This is short and Moeen takes on the challenge of pulling it. He hammers it over the square leg fence.
FOUR! Wonderful timing again! Fuller and on off, this is caressed through covers for a boundary.
WIDE! Shorter and down leg, Moeen lets it through. Wided.
Goes short again, Buttler was ready for it, he pulls it through mid-wicket for one this time.
Now follows the boundary with a single as this is pushed through covers.
FOUR! Lovely timing! Shorter and around off, Moeen opens the face of the bat and guides it past point for a boundary.
Touch short, outside off. Jos Buttler punches it through covers for a brace. 10 runs off the over. England are lifting the mood around the stadium now.
On off, blocked back to the bowler.
This is really good running! Floated and full, on off. Jos Buttler chops it to point and take two.
SIX! ALL THE WAY! Jos Buttler is on a roll now. It is very full and on off. Jos Buttler gets low and tonks it over the long on fence for a maximum.
On off, blocked out.
Tossed up, on off. Buttler pushes it out.
On a length, around off, blocked out. Three dots in a row to end the over.
Back of a good length, it flies off the deck as well, on the bodyline. Moeen Ali does not read it quickly but gets his blade up in time to block it out.
Woah! Mohammed Siraj comes up with a beauty. A scrambled seam this time, on a length, just outside off, shaping away a touch. Moeen Ali tries to chase it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Full length, outside off. Jos Buttler strides and tries to drive it away to the off side. It takes the inner half and goes towards mid on. They take one.
WIDE! Length ball, angled down leg. Jos Buttler tries to flick it away but misses. Wide called.

FOUR! Jos Buttler looks to be back at his best after getting struck twice on his helmet. This is short and outside off, which gives freedom to Buttler to extend his arms. He does so and pulls it powerfully through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full length, angled down leg. Buttler blocks it out.
Floated and full, outside off. Buttler drives it through covers for a single. 5 runs off the over then.
In the air but safe! Looped up, around off. Ali drives it aerially towards mid off. There is no fielder inside the circle and they take one.
Tossed up, full and on off. Buttler pushes it to the left of the bowler. Chahal puts in a dive to his left but the ball sneaks through. They take one.
Fuller, on off. Moeen Ali lunges and flicks it to mid-wicket for another single.
Much straighter, on middle. Jos Buttler drives it to mid off with soft hands and crosses.
Looped up, on the pads, Buttler tucks it to square leg.

Full length, outside off. Moeen Ali drives it to point on the up. The fielder makes a sharp stop. A great over by Mohammed Siraj comes to an end. An over in which Jos Buttler donned three different helmets.
The physio is out yet again as Buttler is struck on the helmet again. Another concussion check will be done.
LEG BYE! Back of a length, on the body. Jos Buttler misses his heave across the line. The ball lobs towards third man off the helmet. They cross for a leg bye.
Length ball, outside off. Jos Buttler goes for the punch but gets it back to the bowler off the inner half.
Nips back in! A length ball, outside off, shaping in. Jos Buttler plays all around it and gets rapped on his pads. Going down leg.
The physio is out to have a look! To do the mandatory concussion check! He seems fine now and is good to go. It took some time as they were getting his helmet changed.

Back of a length, on the bodyline. Jos Buttler tries to go for the hook shot but misses. He gets pinged on his helmet. Mohammed Siraj checks up on the batter and the English skipper shows a thumbs up. Although the physio will make his way out for the mandatory concussion check.
Length ball, on off. Buttler pushes it to cover.

WIDE! Mohammed Siraj starts his second spell with a loosener. It is full, angled down leg. Jos Buttler tries to flick it away but misses. Rishabh Pant makes a full-stretched dive to his left to make a sharp stop. Wided.
Change! Mohammed Siraj is back on.
Full and outside off. Jos Buttler pushes it to point for a single. Just two runs off the over then.
Floated and full, on middle and leg. Jos Buttler defends it to mid on.
Chahal gives it a good flight and lands it outside off. Ali drives it to covers for one.
Slightly quicker and outside off. Moeen Ali tries to drive it away but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Tossed up, outside off. Moeen Ali fends it to first slip.
Chahal starts his spell with a dot! Loopy ball, full and on off. Ali drives it to cover on the up but finds the fielder.
Change! Yuzvendra Chahal is on!
Back of a length, outside off. Ali cuts it to backward point for a single.
Length ball, on the pads, Ali flicks it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length, around off, moving away. Moeen Ali sways away from the line of the delivery.
Swing and a miss! It is touch fuller, outside off, shaping away from the left-hander. Moeen Ali looks to drive it through the off side but only connects with thin air.
Length ball, around off. Ali hangs back and pushes it to point.
Full length, wide outside off. Jos Buttler reaches out and drives it towards mid off. Hardik Pandya fumbles there which allows the batters to cross. Pandya puts his hand up and apologises.
Finally a short ball comes out. It is on middle. Ali ducks under it. Third maiden over for Hardik Pandya, this one is wicketless.
Five dots in a row! Fraction short, on the body. Ali lifts his front leg and tries to pull it away. Moeen Ali misses and gets hit on his body.
Good length, at 132 clicks. Moeen Ali stays inside the crease and defends it out.
Good-length ball, on top of off. This one does not angle across. Moeen Ali closes the face of the blade and nudges it to mid-wicket.
Length ball, on leg. Ali blocks it out watchfully.

Hardik Pandya is bowling with fire here. A sharp bouncer, on off. Ali ducks under it without any hesitation. Well, there is some change in field. Short leg comes in place with a short square leg fielder.
Moeen Ali gets off the mark! Length ball, on the pads, Ali tucks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Jos Buttler cuts it to deep point for a single.
Length ball, on the pads, Jos Buttler flicks it to the leg side.
Just short! It is full and on off. Jos Buttler leans in and drives it towards mid off on the up with soft hands. Axar Patel runs forward, puts in a dive but is unable to gather the ball safely.
This one zips past the off pole. It is on a length, outside off, nips in off the deck. Jos Buttler stays rooted inside the crease and goes for the drive, but gets beaten on the inside edge.
FOUR! Incredible shot. A length ball, outside off. Jos Buttler drives it through the gap at covers on the front foot and finds the boundary.
Incredible start by Hardik Pandya. His spell until now reads 3-2-2-2. A wicket-maiden for the all-rounder. Length ball, on off. Ali blocks it out watchfully.
Yet another dot! Back of a length, on leg stump. Ali ducks under this time as well.
A sharp bouncer this time, on middle. Ali ducks under it and leaves it alone.
Length ball, on middle. Ali stays back and fends it out on the back foot.

DRINKS! Hardik Pandya picks up his second wicket and India have their noses in front yet again in this innings. Pandya and Krishna are bowling really well in tandem here and would be aiming to take a couple more wickets to see the tail of England. Moeen Ali is the new man in for the hosts. Can he take his side to safer shores?

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Hardik Pandya follows a dot ball with a wicket. This is his second wicket and big one as India sees the back of Ben Stokes. Hardik Pandya thinks like a batsman here. He sees Stokes coming down the track and rushes him with a shorter delivery, on middle and leg. The ball gets big on Stokes, he tries to heave across the line with a short jab but could not got through with his shot. It flies off the top edge above the batter to his right. Hardik Pandya sprints forward and gathers the ball safely. India back on the driving seat here.
Length ball, on off. Ben Stokes fends it out to safety. Pandya starts his third over with a dot.
Two more! Outside off, Buttler waits and then guides it past point for two.
Fails to find the gap again! Length and on off, this is guided to point.
Confusion but safe! Shorter and around off, Buttler guides it towards point and wants a run, he comes quite someway down the track but is sent back.
That is a good short one! Outside off, left alone. Wided though, it was a tad too high.
He gets off strike too! On middle, Stokes looks to defend, it goes off the inner half through square leg for one.
A quick run! Shorter and on off, this is pushed towards cover for one. Stokes now gets on strike.
Well stopped! Shorter and on off, Buttler guides it towards point. The fielder dives to his left and stops it well.
This will make Buttler feel good! He gets off the mark on the 9th ball he faces! Shorter and outside off, this is cut through point for one.
Another dot! Pressure building on Jos here! Good length and on off, Buttler guides it to point.
Another one on a length and on off, this is blocked.
Buttler is still to get off the mark! Short and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Back of a length and on off, this is guided to point.
A good short one, well-directed. Stokes looks to pull, it goes more off the splice down to fine leg for one.
Went hard at the ball there! Length and on off, Buttler looks to drive it on the up, it goes uppishly but lands short of the fielder at cover. Another good over from India. Consecutive ones.
Well bowled again! Length and on off, Buttler plays it to point.
Shortish and on off, makes the batter play again. It is pushed to cover.
Gets off strike! On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
BEATEN! All of a sudden, the ball has started to do a bit again. Length and on off, this lands on off and then moves away. Stokes pushes at it and gets beaten.
This one zips through! Back of a length and on middle, defended.
Powerplay 1 comes to an end! That means now 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle until the end of the 40th over.
A wicket-maiden from Pandya! Brilliant. Just the kind of over his side needed! Length and on off, kept out.
Jos Buttler comes in at number 5. Can the skipper take his side out of trouble here?

OUT! TAKEN! Hardik Pandya comes and he strikes! Breaks the partnership that was looking so dangerous. Also, gets rid of Roy who seemed in his elements. Important wicket. The extra bounce does the trick. Short and on middle, Roy looks to pull, he fails to get on top of the bounce, it goes off the top edge towards Pant who takes an easy catch. Welcome, welcome wicket. Can India build on this now? They are back on top we believe.
Commentary.Howout: c Rishabh Pant b Hardik Pandya

Commentary.Commentary: Make that 4 dots in a row! On middle, it is kept out.
That has been clubbed but to the fielder! Shorter and on middle, Roy slaps it to mid on. Three dots to begin with.
Finds the fielder! Shortish and outside off, Roy slaps it but to cover-point.
Back of a length and on middle, defended.
The swing has gone now and this seems a belter! Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one more.
A little too straight from Kirshna, Stokes works it down to fine leg and takes one.
This is worked around the corner for one.
Bangs it short again and on middle, Roy stands back and defends it onto the ground.
FOUR! Chipped in the air and into the fence! On middle, yet again, Roy makes great use of his wrists. He manages to whip it over the square leg fielder and this one races away.
Back of a length and on middle, blocked.
Short ball, around leg. Stokes tries to pull it away but mistimes it to mid-wicket.
Make that 8. It is a length ball, outside off. Roy plays it late towards third man and crosses.
Back of a length, outside off. Roy cuts it through point for a couple more runs. 9 runs off the over already.
FOUR! The runs are coming in quick succession now. This is a short ball, almost chest heigh. Jason Roy stays on his back foot and pulls it ferociously for a boundary at deep mid-wicket.
Length ball, on the pads. Roy stays back and flicks it to deep square leg for a brace.
A misfield and a run! On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket, the fielder misfields and a single taken. The early advantage India had is slipping away.

Two more! Another outrageous stroke! This is outside off, Roy shuffles across and whips it over mid-wicket for two. Did not get all of it but to whip it from there was quite courageous. Strong wrists.
On middle, Roy watches it and plays it to mid on.
He is oozing in confidence here now. Going after every delivery. Steps out but Shami pulls his length back. Stokes swings, it goes off the inside edge onto the leg side for one.

FOUR! The last one was brute force, this was glorious! What a shot. Two boundaries in a row, the last one off the back foot and this off the front foot. Fuller and on off, Stokes shows the maker's name and creams it past mid off. Also, holds the pose for the cameras.
FOUR! What a shot that is! It went to the fence like a tracer bullet! Short and on middle, this is hammered again through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length and on middle, Stokes gets right behind the line of it and defends it on the off side.
FOUR! Squeezes it out well and the last ball spoils the over a little! Roy steps out, Siraj goes for the yorker on middle. Roy manages to squeeze it past point and into the fence.
Back of a length and on off, Roy pushes it to covers.
Nicely adjusted by Stokes! Stokes dances down the track, this is banged in short and on middle. Stokes guides it down to third man after watching the ball closely and takes one.
Does not find the gap! Length and on off, Stokes slams it hard but to covers.
That is a good short one again, angling away from middle. Stokes pulls out of the pull shot.
On the shorter side and on middle, Stokes plays it to mid on.
WIDE! Short but down the leg side. Stokes looks to pull but misses. Wided.
Timed really well again! Roy has started well today! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for a couple. Despite the two wickets, England going at a good rate here.

That is a brilliant stop! Krishna saves three there! Stokes thumped that. He made room, came down the track and hammered it to the right of mid off. Krishna dives and gets a hand to it, a strong hand. Three saved for his side.
Too high! Stokes walks across, Shami bowls a length ball around off, gets it to swing back in. Stokes looks to whip it but misses to get hit near the box.
Back of a length and on off, Stokes pushes it to mid off.
Now follows the boundary with a run! On middle, this is nudged on the leg side for one.
FOUR! THUMPED! That has been powered away by Roy! Boundaries flowing now! Shami goes short and Roy has no problem in pulling it through square leg for another boundary.
A dot to end but a good over for England. Length and on off, this is blocked.

FOUR! JUST OVER! Second boundary in the over and the ball is racing off the bat! On the pads, Stokes flicks it uppishly but wide of the diving fielder at square leg and into the fence. This has been an action-packed start to the game.
Siraj gets away with one there! This is short and outside off, asking to be hit. Stokes hammers it but straight to point.
FOUR! That is timed brilliantly! That shot just shows there is nothing wrong with this wicket. Back of a length and on off, Stokes punches it through covers and bags his first boundary.

Hardik takes a tumble there! Stokes yet again gets away with one. Looks to be aggressive. Steps out and looks to loft it over mid off but it goes more off the toe end of the blade. Clears Pandya though who slips as he tries to pick the ball up. Two taken.
Fuller, gets it to tail back in from off, Stokes pushes it to mid off.
Roy continues to drive on the up! Length and on off, Roy pushes it to mid on.

Quick run and Stokes is off the mark! Had there been a direct hit, Stokes was a goner! Length and on middle, this is pushed to mid on. Stokes takes off. Krishna gets to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
That just goes past the off pole! From around the wicket now Shami to the left-hander. It is on a length and outside off. Comes in with the angle. Left alone well.

Almost! Almost another one! Not sure if that is the right shot with the ball coming back in. This is outside off, well outside off. Comes back in a touch. Roy goes after it away from the body, but it takes the inside edge, beats the off pole and runs down to fine leg for one.
This is going down leg! Shami is slightly fuller this time but he brings it back in from around middle. Roy looks to drive it through mid on but misses to get hit on the pads.
That is the ball to bowl to Roy! The inswinger, it comes back in from outside off and it is on a length. Roy plays it well as he pushes it to mid on.

OUT! CAUGHT AT SLIPS! Joe Root departs on a 3-ball duck. Mohammed Siraj grabs two wickets in a jiffy. England now see their second batter walk out without disturbing the scorers. They are surely in a spot of bother. It is a length ball, around off, shaping away but late. Joe Root stays inside the crease and tries to defend it out but squares up a bit. It flies off the outside edge towards second slip. Rohit Sharma keeps his eyes on the ball and takes a solid catch. Ben Stokes walks in next.
Commentary.Howout: c Rohit Sharma b Mohammed Siraj

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, outside off. Joe Root leaves it alone for the keeper.
Length ball, on the pads, Root flicks it to the leg side.
Joe Root is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mohammed Siraj takes no time to make a statement after replacing the man in form Jasprit Bumrah. Siraj draws first blood, only on his third delivery to send back Jonny Bairstow for a duck. Just the start India were after. It is full and on off. Jonny Bairstow tries to play it across the line and does so a bit early. It takes the leading edge and lobs towards mid off. Shreyas Iyer, the substitute fielder, takes a dolly.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Shreyas Iyer b Mohammed Siraj

Commentary.Commentary: BEAUTY! It is a length ball, on the fifth stump. This one holds its line. Jonny Bairstow hangs his blade away from his body but luckily does not nick it behind.
Back of a length, outside off. Jonny Bairstow looks to cut it away but does not time it well. Straight to the fielder.
Mohammed Siraj to steam in from the other end with the second new ball.

Length ball, on the fourth stump. This one flies off the deck. Jason Roy tries to chase it but decides to make a late leave. The ball zips past the outside edge. A good end to an untidy over by Shami.
Good length, outside off, shaping away. Jason Roy covers his stumps and shoulders his arms at it.

FOUR! Easy pickings for Roy. It is a perfect start for the opener. It is full, on middle and leg. Jason Roy stays back and flicks it along the ground through mid-wicket for a boundary. The third one in the over.
A length ball, on off. Roy blocks it to mid on with full face.
FOUR! In the air but safe. It is a length ball, on the pads. Roy stays back and clips it aerially past the square leg fielder for a boundary.

FOUR! Jason Roy and England are off the mark in fine fashion. A confident shot by Roy to get off the mark. It is very full, on the fourth stump. A half-volley. Jason Roy leans in and drives it down the ground past mid off for a boundary.

The match is set to begin. There are some clouds hovering around, hopefully, the wind blows them away. Let's keep our fingers crossed for an uninterrupted match. The Indian players stride out to the middle, followed by Jason Roy and Jonny Bairstow who walk out to open for the hosts. It will be Mohammad Shami to start with the new ball. Here we go...

Jos Buttler, the English skipper says they wanted to bat. Adds it may swing at the start but he is happy. States it is going to be a good game, a good crowd and he is excited. Informs they are unchanged.

Rohit Sharma, the skipper of India, says it looks like a good track and it seems like it won’t change a lot. Adds it is a series decider and on this tour they have played some good cricket but they got their learnings from last game and they don’t want to repeat those mistakes. Adds they have bowled well in this tour so far and he hopes that continues. Informs they have one change, Bumrah sits out due to injury and Siraj comes in.
England (Unchanged Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Jonny Bairstow, Joe Root, Ben Stokes, Jos Buttler (C/WK), Liam Livingstone, Moeen Ali, David Willey, Craig Overton, Brydon Carse, Reece Topley.

India (Playing XI) - Rohit Sharma (C), Shikhar Dhawan, Virat Kohli, Suryakumar Yadav, Rishabh Pant (WK), Hardik Pandya, Ravindra Jadeja, Mohammad Shami, Mohammed Siraj (In for Jasprit Bumrah), Prasidh Krishna, Yuzvendra Chahal.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of India. They have opted to BOWL first.
PITCH REPORT - The deck is hard, the pacers will get a good carry. There is some grass on the track as well to not let the heat crack it up.
